verdict.rationale: MoQ Relay is a media relay/CDN server, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a plausible ecosystem offering and the axis applies. The evidence shows only an llms.txt file, a CLI and SDK libraries; none of these is an MCP server, and an llms.txt file is an adjacent AI-readability feature that earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
